work_title: Example of a Bitcoin transaction parsing in ErgoScript
description: Correction (2026-08-11): this was previously marked awaiting-review with a description stating the upstream PR had been merged. That was wrong on my part - https://github.com/ergoplatform/sigmastate-interpreter/pull/1177 is still open and issue #1114 is still open. Reverting to in-progress until the PR is actually merged; I will set awaiting-review only after that. Work: an ErgoScript contract parsing a real Bitcoin transaction, plus 10 tests.
